comparison_note: The prior run used 32 visits; this revised player uses 128. These are player-configuration comparisons, not an equal-compute ablation.

summary.interpretation: Development evidence only. UNKNOWN is excluded from complete-game rates and separately bounded; draws are not wins.

tactical_diagnostics.interpretation: Capture counts describe observed play, not a proof of optimal moves. Seeded trajectories can be correlated; Wilson intervals are descriptive development evidence.
